scares.description: Jake sees the Indian man following Gloria at the mall through Bellini’s store window.
The Indian man appears as the elevator door opens.
Jake’s claustrophobia forces him against the tunnel wall in a state of panic.
Gloria walks into her bedroom just as the burglar jumps behind a door.
The intruder presses the moving drill bit into Gloria’s back.
Jake hears Gloria screaming as the drill bit punctures through the ceiling.
Two hands grab Jake’s neck as he peers into the grave where Holly has been buried.
